definition: Sergey Levine is a computer scientist and professor at UC Berkeley specializing in robotics and machine learning.
details: He is a co-founder of the company Physical Intelligence.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. And that idea, made concrete, is Sergey Levine.
